# The Poor Penman

> A pen and gear review blog exploring quality writing instruments, EDC products, and the art of thoughtful consumption.

The Poor Penman is a personal blog by Paul dedicated to reviewing pens, watches, notebooks, and everyday carry gear. The site emphasizes finding products worth owning and using, with a focus on fountain pens, mechanical writing instruments, and curated lifestyle gear.

## Key Topics

- Pen Reviews
- Fountain Pens
- EDC Gear
- Pen Collecting
- Writing Instruments
- Big Idea Design
- Field Watches
- Product Reviews
- Gear Reviews
- Stationery Hobby
- Mayfair Pens
- Mechanical Pens
- Product Giveaways
- Writing Accessories
- Pen Enthusiast

## Core Pages

- [The Poor Penman – Seeking What's Worth It](https://thepoorpenman.com): Homepage showcasing pen reviews, gear reviews, and product giveaways
- [What's My Story – The Poor Penman](https://thepoorpenman.com/whats-my-story): Author Paul's personal story and introduction to The Poor Penman blog

## Pen & Fountain Pen Reviews

- [Mayfair Pens Noldor Review (Extended Edition) – The Poor Penman](https://thepoorpenman.com/2025/11/10/mayfair-pens-noldor-review-extended-edition): Extended fountain pen review of Mayfair Pens Noldor resin pen
- [The Poor Penman – Page 2 – Seeking What's Worth It](https://thepoorpenman.com/page/2): Archive page featuring pen reviews from Diplomat, Karas Pen Co., and others

## Gear & Watch Reviews

- [Big Idea Design Ti Base Line Field Watch Review – The Poor Penman](https://thepoorpenman.com/2025/12/31/big-idea-design-ti-base-line-field-watch-review): In-depth review of Big Idea Design titanium field watch with mecha-quartz
- [Plotter Mini5, But Make It A Wallet – The Poor Penman](https://thepoorpenman.com/2025/08/28/plotter-mini5-but-make-it-a-wallet): Creative review of using Plotter Mini5 notebook as EDC wallet
